alt_orders.criteria: Essential = recommended for newcomers by at least two sources marked selective:true, with no source explicitly calling it skippable/optional. Later seasons/books/films of an essential series are essential too. selective:true means the source curates: it recommends a subset (a beginner list, a 'best of', an 'essential' list), or labels some entries optional or skippable. A complete list that only states an order is selective:false. Everything else that at least one source lists is optional. supported_by = indices of sources whose lists (any order they print) include the unit; the 'why' names which selective sources recommend it ('Recommended for newcomers by sources [...]'). Later seasons of an essential series also count as essential, because they continue the same story (guides written before a season came out cannot list it).
